canonical_source.title: Mundari: The myth of a language without word classes
canonical_source.repository: Australian National University Open Research Repository

basis: DOI metadata exposed by ANU record
identity_verification.canonicalization_rule: publisher/DOI/repository/PDF manifestations are one underlying article identity

dependency_and_scope.important_note: The abstract explicitly states that the article reanalyses Hoffmann's corpus and also uses substantial new data. Therefore article-level classification as wholly independent non-Mundarica evidence would be invalid.
dependency_and_scope.promotion_rule: Only exact passages/examples whose provenance and reuse basis are resolved may be promoted; Hoffmann/Mundarica-derived material must retain dependency and cannot count as independent corroboration.

rights_access_consent.rule: Open repository access does not by itself establish a redistribution licence, participant/consultant reuse consent, or unrestricted cultural permission.

exact_locator_ingestion.reason: This run verified metadata and open-access availability but did not obtain and checksum immutable lawful PDF bytes or complete printed-page/PDF-page concordance and passage-level provenance classification.

release_effect: gap reduced at identity/metadata/access level; exact-locator evidence promotion remains gated
